│ balance_goal            │ off                                     │ Stop the bot when the balance reaches this                                             │
│ hard_cap                │ off                                     │ Never place a bet that would pass max_loss or the balance floor                        │

│ hybrid_press_floor      │ 0.00000000                              │ Profit at which press hands back to the opening strategy                               │

│ hybrid_press_bet        │ 1                                       │ First press bet, as a multiple of base_bet                                             │
│ profit_increment        │ off                                     │ Bump base_bet by this at every profit milestone                                        │
│ profit_threshold        │ off                                     │ Profit interval between increments                                                     │
│ profit_increment_scope  │ session                                 │ session = each session's profit · run = total since run start (wolfctl run-reset)      │
